earlier_scan.source_named: Only Kluge 2011 SIL sociolinguistic survey cited on Glottolog (sil.org 403); no grammar/phonology of Ede Idaca located.

sources.citation: Kluge, Angela (2007). A synchronic lexical study of the Ede language continuum of West Africa: The effects of different similarity judgment criteria. Afrikanistik online 2007, 34 pp. doi:10.18716/ojs/aaeo/2007_3518
sources.note: Lexicostatistical study of 28 Ede varieties; 'stress' occurs only as MDS Kruskal stress; no phonological stress or tone statement. Para. 36 (p. 8) names the Idaca descriptive literature: Kouyomou 1986 (phonology), 1991c (grammar), Baloubi 2004.
